tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — the cool lavender-grey ground every section sits on.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the services panel, testimonial and timeline cards, the social bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders where a shadow is not enough, the skill ring track. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text, on surface and surface-raised (14:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, descriptions, metadata, on surface and surface-raised (5.6:1+ light, 7:1+ dark).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: The brand field: large background panels behind the page, the dot-grid band. Fill only; text on it is on-violet.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a violet fill (7.2:1 light, 5.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-violet-dim
tokens.usage: The decorative dot grid printed on violet. Never text.

tokens.name: violet-ink
tokens.usage: Violet as text or icon: links, the violet service chip glyph, focus ring; on surface, surface-raised and violet-soft.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chip and badge grounds behind violet-ink.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Floating decorative shapes — the soft diamonds and squiggles scattered around sections. Never text or a control.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The one action colour: primary button fill, eyebrow labels, the 'Hello,' greeting, active timeline node. As text on surface, surface-raised and coral-soft.

tokens.name: on-coral
tokens.usage: Text on a coral fill — the primary button label.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Coral-tinted chip grounds and the outline button's hover.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Service chip glyph (UI/UX), info accents; on surface-raised and sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Sky chip ground.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Service chip glyph (Motion), success; on surface-raised and mint-soft.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Mint chip ground.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Service chip glyph (Development), warm accents; on surface-raised and sun-soft.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Sun chip ground.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, offset 2px, on every surface (6.6:1 light, 7:1 dark).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero role line, one per page, uppercase, ink.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings, uppercase, under an eyebrow.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above every section title, uppercase, coral.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and item titles: services, timeline, skills.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Freelance UX/UI designer who loves a good video game.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Clear thinking, careful craft, on time.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons and the person name in a testimonial.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudge, dot radius.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside tight groups (eyebrow to title).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; chip to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Small card padding; list gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutters; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large card padding; column gap in the services grid.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between section heading and content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding (the white services panel).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, image frames — the system is nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, decorative diamonds.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating trays (the social bar's left end, the button tray).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon chips, social buttons — anything you press is round.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every raised card and panel. Soft, wide, violet-tinted; never a hard drop.

tokens.name: shadow-coral
tokens.usage: Primary button only — the coral glow under 'Hire Me'.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: Service icon chips and social buttons.
